listeningQuestions.audio: A healthy lifestyle includes good food, exercise and enough sleep.
opts: 健康的生活方式包括良好饮食、运动和充足睡眠。

listeningQuestions.audio: Sugary drinks just add extra calories with little benefit.
opts: 含糖饮料只是增加多余热量,益处很少。

listeningQuestions.audio: Exercise builds energy rather than using it up.
opts: 运动能增加精力,而非消耗精力。

listeningQuestions.audio: Teenagers should get eight to ten hours of sleep each night.
opts: 青少年每晚睡两小时就够。
青少年每晚应睡八到十小时。

listeningQuestions.audio: Washing your hands with soap removes the most germs.
opts: 用肥皂洗手能去除最多的细菌。

listeningQuestions.audio: Proper brushing should take at least two minutes.
opts: 正确刷牙至少要两分钟。

quizQuestions.q: Exercise can ____ your blood pressure and improve heart health.（降低)
Try to ____ processed foods with fresh fruits and vegetables.（替换)
A fitness app helps you keep ____ of how active you are.（了解……的动态:keep ___ of)
Not getting enough sleep can make you ____ and easily annoyed.（脾气坏的)
____ young, you should start building healthy habits early.
See a doctor immediately ____ necessary, rather than wait at home.
He looks much healthier than his cousin ____.
– Would you like to join our dance club? – Yes, I'd love ____.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 晚饭后散步有助于消化。
quizQuestions.audio: A short walk after dinner helps with digestion.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 蓝区的人过着低压力的生活。
quizQuestions.audio: People in the Blue Zones live a low-stress life.

reading.passage: When you feel tired, a morning workout is often better than an extra hour of sleep. A single session of exercise can lower your stress, improve your heart health and even leave you with more energy. Working out does not use up your energy; it builds it.
reading.passageCn: 当你感到疲惫时,晨练往往比多睡一小时更好。一次锻炼就能减轻压力、改善心脏健康,甚至让你更有精力。锻炼不会耗尽精力,反而会增加精力。

questions.q: What is often better than an extra hour of sleep?
What does the passage say a workout does to your energy?
opts: It quickly uses it all up.
It builds it rather than using it up.
It has no effect on it.

writing.prompt: A classmate asks you for advice about a health problem. Write a short reply: name one likely cause and give two practical solutions.
writing.promptCn: 一位同学就健康问题向你求助。写一段简短回信:指出一个可能原因,并给出两条切实可行的办法(试着用省略结构,如 If (it is) necessary…)。

lines.text: Should we just get pizza and soda for lunch?
lines.cn: 我们午饭就吃披萨喝汽水好吗?

lines.text: Let's try something healthier. I'm taking charge of my diet.
lines.cn: 试试更健康的吧。我正在掌管自己的饮食。

lines.text: But I really want a soda.
Sugary drinks just add extra calories. Why not have water?
lines.cn: 含糖饮料只是增加多余热量,何不喝水呢?

lines.text: I'm always tired and have no energy after class.
lines.cn: 我下课后总是很累,没有精力。

lines.text: Try exercising. It builds energy instead of using it up.
lines.cn: 试试运动吧,它能增加而非消耗精力。

lines.text: But I'm too tired to start.
Then come jogging with me. It's more fun with a friend.
lines.cn: 那就和我一起慢跑吧,有朋友更有趣。
